_comment: Second poll of the same aggregator, eleven days later. Same shape, different content: CB-4411 has been retitled and its deadline extended, CB-4412 and CB-4414 are byte-identical to the first poll, CB-4415 has vanished from the feed without saying so, and CB-4416 now states it has closed. Covers retitle-is-the-same-job, DEADLINE_CHANGED, JOB_UPDATED, JOB_CLOSED and JOB_REMOVED in one pass.
